summary.prose: Building this Story turns the scratchpad document view from a read-only <pre> into an editable in-plugin textarea with a safe save round-trip. Four tasks, in dependency order: a new ScratchStore.updateScratch that rewrites the .md under the store's existing validation plus exclusive no-follow temp-write and unlink/link no-clobber publish (t1); a new document-channel scratch-save/scratch-saved message contract in scratch-panels.ts that leaves the chat channel untouched (t2); the document view reshape — textarea, dirty tracking, save button + Ctrl/Cmd+S, gen-guarded replies, textarea-selection send-to-chat — with the new onScratchSave seam and replySaved (t3); and the scratch-host 'scratch-save' route plus its extension.ts wiring, with fakes-backed unit, contract and integration tests throughout (t4).

acceptanceChecks: updateScratch(id, text) exists on the ScratchStore interface and nodeScratchFs implementation
happy path replaces file content with the full text, bumps mtime, leaves no temp file

id validation refusals: outside-root / non-.md / non-regular / symlink → ScratchRefused; missing file → ScratchNotFound; write/publish failure → ScratchStoreError with destination untouched and temp unlinked
temp file created exclusively and no-follow (O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW; EEXIST/ELOOP on an occupied or symlinked temp name aborts the save)

publish is unlink(destination)+link(temp,destination)+unlink(temp) — never rename — with destination re-opened O_NOFOLLOW+fstat to confirm the validated inode before unlink, and bounded retry on link EEXIST
fake-scratch-fs.ts extended with writeFileExclusive EEXIST/ELOOP semantics plus link/unlink/open-fstat coverage
tasks.summary: Add ScratchStore.updateScratch(id, text) to vscode-plugin/src/chat/scratch-store.ts under the store's existing validation (inside ~/.insrc/scratches root, *.md basename, lstat regular file, symlink refused, O_NOFOLLOW) plus a new ScratchFs.writeFileExclusive for the exclusive no-follow temp write and unlink/link no-clobber publish (never rename, bounded retry); extend fake-scratch-fs.ts and the existing scratch-store.test.ts with the happy path, refusal/not-found/store-error cases, temp cleanup, and mtime-bump coverage.

tests.name: scratch-store.test.ts: updateScratch happy path writes full text and replaces content; id validation refusal (outside-root, symlink, non-.md) → ScratchRefused; missing file → ScratchNotFound; write failure leaves destination unchanged and unlinks temp; temp path occupied by a symlink or existing file → exclusive create fails (EEXIST/ELOOP) and nothing is written outside the root
scratch-store.test.ts: updateScratch bumps mtime so listScratches reflects the save
